environment.description: Same container image deployed on a Kubernetes pod with a custom OCI runtime configuration. The pod spec includes a localhost seccomp profile (type: Localhost, localhostProfile: 'profiles/webhook-hardened.json') that applies a whitelist-based syscall filter. The profile permits read, write, close, fstat, mmap, mprotect, munmap, brk, rt_sigaction, rt_sigprocmask, ioctl, access, pipe, select, sched_yield, mremap, clone, execve (ONLY with SCMP_ACT_ERRNO for execve), wait4, uname, fcntl, getdents, getcwd, chdir, openat, newfstatat, lseek, getrandom, epoll_create1, epoll_ctl, epoll_wait, eventfd2, futex, nanosleep, clock_gettime, getpid, getuid, getgid, gettid, arch_prctl, set_tid_address, set_robust_list, prlimit64, and connect/socket/bind/sendto/recvfrom/setsockopt/getsockopt ONLY for AF_UNIX domain. The profile returns SCMP_ACT_ERRNO (EPERM) for socket() calls with AF_INET, AF_INET6, or AF_NETLINK domain arguments. Additionally, the Kubernetes NetworkPolicy for this namespace restricts egress to only the cluster DNS (kube-dns on port 53/UDP) and a specific allowlist of external webhook receiver CIDRs (10.200.0.0/16) — no access to 169.254.0.0/16 or any RFC1918 ranges outside the allowed CIDR.

config.seccomp_socket_filter: AF_INET/AF_INET6/AF_NETLINK blocked at syscall level, only AF_UNIX permitted
config.network_policy: egress restricted to kube-dns:53/UDP and 10.200.0.0/16 only
